directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. Output is a volume rate. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成26 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成30 MPa。电动50型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成26 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder: Blmexcavsm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 50 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa. A number in m³/h is a volume rate, and a number in MPa is pressure. Stroke length, cycle rate and price are absent from both the caption and this catalogue row. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder页上的Blmexcavsm。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动50型混凝土泵的理论输送量写成26 m³/h，把最大出口压力写成30 MPa。行程、冲次和价格在说明文字和这一行目录里都没有。

body.en: Output is a volume rate. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. The Xingtai row does not list a service interval, a seal torque, an export destination or a job case. Those shown extras are still not a stroke length.
body.zh: 电动50型混凝土泵这一页把理论输送量写成26 m³/h，把最大出口压力单独写成30 MPa。邢台这一行没有标出保养小时间隔、密封扭矩、出口国家或工程案例。

body.en: Pressure is a separate entry on the same sheet. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。

body.en: On the Electric 50 Concrete Pump sheet, Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不把这句说明当成电动50型混凝土泵的铭牌。

question.en: What output does the Electric 50 Concrete Pump sheet list?
question.zh: 电动50型混凝土泵这一页的输送量标出多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是26 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder画面里印出的数字。

question.en: What pressure entry is on the same sheet?
question.zh: 同一页的压力格是多少？

answer.en: Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder.
answer.zh: 最大出口压力是30 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. The sheet leaves stroke length, cycle rate and price unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder.
answer.zh: 没有。这一页没有标出行程、冲次和价格。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hydraulic_cylinder画面里印出的数字。
